run_stack_train_object_videos: run the script to stack training object videos from input folders into a grid layout
run_main: run the main function to process video clips and create stacked output videos
run_get_parser: run get_parser to create an argparse parser with input_root and output_folder arguments
refactor_main_resize_width: refactor the main function to support a configurable video resize width instead of hardcoded 512
refactor_main_max_cols: refactor the main function to support a configurable number of columns instead of hardcoded 5
